26: // ConfigFromDBConfig maps a config.DBConfig to the dao.Config used to open
27: // the shared database handle. dao.Open keys its idempotence on this config
28: // identity, so every call site that opens the handle before app startup
29: // (schema init, integration/mock-debug bootstrap) must build the dao config
30: // through this helper — keeping the two mappings from drifting.
31: func ConfigFromDBConfig(src *config.DBConfig) (dao.Config, error) {
32: 	if src == nil {
33: 		return dao.Config{}, errors.New("db config is nil")
34: 	}
35: 	return dao.Config{
36: 		Driver:                      src.Driver,
37: 		Addr:                        src.Addr,
38: 		User:                        src.User,
39: 		Pwd:                         src.Pwd,
40: 		DBName:                      src.DBName,
41: 		ConnTimeoutSeconds:          src.ConnTimeout,
